days.title: Stop Boosting Posts. Start Capturing Buyers Who Are Already Searching.
days.core_concept: Difference between Facebook post boosting and Google Search Ads. Why searching 'emergency plumber near me' or 'dentist near me' on Google indicates an urgent, high-intent ready-to-buy prospect.
days.target_audience: Local Business Owners (Clinics, Dentists, Plumbers, HVAC, Lawyers, Home Services)
days.goal: Capture local business owners' attention and shift mindset from social interruption to high-intent search.
days.graphic_subtitle: Why Google Search ads beat Facebook boosting for local businesses every time.

days.title: Your Google Ads Budget Is Leaking Through These 5 Search Terms.
days.core_concept: Negative keywords, search terms report analysis, and blocking irrelevant junk clicks. For example: stopping a paid plumbing service ad from triggering on 'plumbing jobs' or 'free plumbing course'.
days.target_audience: Local Business Owners & In-house Marketers burning ad spend
days.goal: Demonstrate deep technical expertise, negative keyword fortress, and instant cost savings.
days.graphic_subtitle: How negative keywords save local businesses 35%+ of ad budget.

days.title: Your Ads May Be Generating Leads That Your Tracking Cannot See.
days.core_concept: Broken conversion tags, missing form submissions, untracked phone calls, and how distorted conversion data ruins Google/Meta smart bidding algorithm optimization.
days.target_audience: Founders, Agency Owners & Service Businesses with poor ad results
days.goal: Generate qualified inbound inquiries for a Full Tracking Audit.
days.graphic_subtitle: When your pixel misses conversions, your ad networks start guessing.

days.title: Browser Pixels Alone Are No Longer the Whole Tracking Strategy.
days.core_concept: Browser-side vs server-side tracking, how sGTM handles secure data routing, bypassing Safari ITP and ad-blockers, and where common implementation mistakes happen.
days.goal: Establish advanced technical authority in Server-Side Google Tag Manager (sGTM).
days.graphic_subtitle: Recover 30%+ lost conversions blocked by Safari ITP and ad blockers.

days.title: Installing Meta Pixel Is Easy. Building Reliable Conversion Tracking Is Not.
days.core_concept: Dual tracking with Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI), proper event deduplication using event_id, customer information parameters, and achieving 9.0+ Event Match Quality (EMQ).
days.target_audience: E-commerce Brands, Shopify Merchants & Marketing Agencies
days.goal: Attract high-ticket e-commerce brands needing flawless CAPI architecture.
days.graphic_subtitle: Achieve 9+/10 Event Match Quality with bulletproof deduplication.

days.title: If GA4 Reports Purchases Incorrectly, Your ROAS May Be Misleading.
days.core_concept: Validating the e-commerce funnel (view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase), eliminating duplicate transaction IDs, and ensuring GA4 matches bank revenue.
days.goal: Build deep credibility with e-commerce owners making scaling decisions on bad data.
days.graphic_subtitle: Ensure your Google Analytics 4 purchase revenue matches your bank account.

days.title: More Leads Won't Fix Your Business If They Never Become Customers.
days.core_concept: Lead volume vs lead quality. Call tracking, CRM synchronization, and optimizing Google Ads for qualified consults instead of tire-kickers.
days.target_audience: Dentists, Clinics, Law Firms, High-Ticket Service Businesses
days.goal: Target high-ticket local businesses tired of low-quality lead forms.
days.graphic_subtitle: Optimize Google Ads for booked consults, not empty form-fills.

days.title: Stop Optimizing for Cheap Leads. Start Measuring Revenue.
days.core_concept: Offline Conversion Import (OCI) from CRM into Google Ads. Passing closed-won deal values so Google Smart Bidding targets clients who actually spend money.
days.target_audience: Agency Owners, B2B Founders & High-Ticket Lead Gen
days.goal: Position Tauhid Ads Lab as an enterprise-grade revenue analytics partner.
days.graphic_subtitle: Train Google Ads AI to bid on leads who write checks, not form spammers.

days.title: A Bigger Google Ads Budget Won't Fix a Broken Campaign.
days.core_concept: Auditing Quality Score, keyword intent, landing page conversion rate, tracking, and location targeting before pouring more ad budget into Google Ads.
days.target_audience: Business Owners spending over $1,000/mo on Google Ads with mediocre returns
days.goal: Show strategic problem-solving and attract scaling accounts.
days.graphic_subtitle: 5 things you must optimize before spending another dollar on Google Ads.

days.title: Before You Spend Another Dollar on Ads, Audit These 7 Things.
days.core_concept: The ultimate comprehensive 7-point audit checklist: conversion tracking, negative keywords, landing pages, call tracking, lead quality, attribution, and revenue reporting.
days.target_audience: All Founders, Local Business Owners, and E-commerce Directors
days.goal: Drive maximum bookings for the Free 30-Minute 1-on-1 Strategy Session with Tauhid Ads Lab.
days.graphic_subtitle: Audit your entire advertising and tracking engine in 30 minutes.
